clips.title: The story
paras: Malfurion Stormrage is the first mortal druid and the revered leader of the night elves alongside High Priestess Tyrande Whisperwind. Renowned for defeating the Burning Legion in both the War of the Ancients and the Third War, he is venerated as the Shan'do, or honored teacher. Currently, he lies trapped in a comatose slumber within the Emerald Dream, leaving the kaldorei without his waking guidance.

Ten thousand years ago, before the Great Sundering shattered ancient Kalimdor, Malfurion studied under the demigod Cenarius. While Queen Azshara and her Highborne caste delved dangerously into the arcane energies of the Well of Eternity, Malfurion turned toward the primal forces of nature, becoming Azeroth's first mortal druid. His suspicions regarding the Highborne proved tragically correct when Azshara's reckless sorcery pierced the veil and summoned Sargeras and the Burning Legion into Azeroth, igniting the catastrophic War of the Ancients.

Alongside Cenarius, Tyrande Whisperwind, and his twin brother Illidan, Malfurion spearheaded the resistance that halted the demon onslaught and closed the portal over the Well of Eternity. Following the world's shattering, Malfurion committed the druids to the Emerald Dream to rebuild and protect Azeroth's living tapestry. Ten millennia later, Tyrande awakened him from his long barrow sleep to confront Archimonde during the Third War, where he rallied the forest spirits at Mount Hyjal to shatter the Burning Legion once more.

Following the Third War, Malfurion returned to his slumber within the Moonglade to commune with the Emerald Dream and replenish his spent power. However, his spirit has failed to return to his physical body, plunging him into an unnatural, comatose state. In Darnassus, Archdruid Fandral Staghelm has assumed the temporal duties of leadership among the Cenarion Circle, while Tyrande and the sisterhood watch anxiously for signs of their great Shan'do's waking.
